# JoJo's Blocks

> JoJo's Blocks is a digital products brand. Its first products are digital PDF coloring books for parents and children — printable at home, screen-free, for learning through play. The books are sold through Gumroad; this website takes no payment itself.

- Website: https://jojosblocks.online/
- Sitemap: https://jojosblocks.online/sitemap.xml
- Pinterest: https://www.pinterest.com/JoJosBlocks/
- Online store (Gumroad): https://jojosblocks.gumroad.com/

## What the website is for

JoJo's Blocks helps parents, preschool teachers and homeschool families find printable coloring and activity books for young children. Every book is a digital PDF: buy it, download it, print the pages at home and color them again and again. No printed books are shipped. No accounts or passwords are needed to browse the website.

## Who the books are for

- Parents of young children looking for calm, screen-free activities
- Preschool teachers and homeschool families
- Children learning letters, animals, community helpers and space themes through coloring, tracing, counting, matching and puzzles

## Products

All prices are in USD. A 10% discount code JOJOS10 is automatically applied at Gumroad checkout, so the price paid is lower than the listed price (shown below in brackets).

### My First ABC Book

- Product page: https://jojosblocks.online/books/my-first-abc-book.html
- Price: $3.99 ($3.59 with JOJOS10)
- Format: digital PDF coloring book, 28 pages, ages 2–4
- What it is: the alphabet A to Z, one letter per page with a picture word (A is for Apple, B is for Ball, C is for Cat), a color guide and letter-tracing practice, with phonics hints.

### My First Animal Explorer

- Product page: https://jojosblocks.online/books/my-first-animal-explorer.html
- Price: $4.99 ($4.49 with JOJOS10)
- Format: digital PDF coloring and activity book, 30 pages, ages 3–6
- What it is: meet lions, elephants, giraffes, pandas, monkeys and more — learn each animal's name, trace the word, count, match and color. Includes a Certificate of Achievement.

### My Little Community Helpers

- Product page: https://jojosblocks.online/books/my-little-community-helpers.html
- Price: $4.99 ($4.49 with JOJOS10)
- Format: digital PDF coloring book, 54 pages, ages 4–7
- What it is: 24 community helpers — doctors, nurses, firefighters, police officers, teachers, veterinarians, electricians, mail carriers and more — with simple job descriptions, big coloring illustrations and a matching activity.

### My Little Space Adventure

- Product page: https://jojosblocks.online/books/my-little-space-adventure.html
- Price: $4.99 ($4.49 with JOJOS10)
- Format: digital PDF coloring and activity book, 42 pages, ages 3–5
- What it is: a story mission with Nova, Zippy the alien and Rocket-7 to find the missing Cosmic Crystal — coloring planets and alien worlds, mazes, puzzles, counting, matching, alien-language decoding and a Space Explorer Quiz, with a Junior Space Explorer certificate.

### Complete Coloring Book Bundle

- Product page: https://jojosblocks.online/books/complete-coloring-book-bundle.html
- Price: $12.99 ($11.69 with JOJOS10)
- Format: digital PDF bundle, 154 pages, ages 2–7 (all four books above)
- What it is: all four books in one bundle — ABC, animals, community helpers and space — for one lower price than buying them separately.

## How buying works

1. Browse the books on the website.
2. Click "Buy Now on Gumroad" on any book.
3. Checkout and payment happen on Gumroad; the PDF download is provided by Gumroad after purchase.
4. Print the pages at home and color them.
